snapshots.subtitle: Mr. Ramsay's wife; mother of eight
snapshots.body: Wife of the philosopher Mr. Ramsay and mother of their eight children. She is hosting her family and a houseful of guests at their summer house on the Isle of Skye, and is knitting a stocking for the lighthouse keeper's little boy.

snapshots.name: Mr. Ramsay
snapshots.subtitle: Mrs. Ramsay's husband; a philosopher
snapshots.body: Mrs. Ramsay's husband and father of their eight children, a philosopher who lectures at universities. Blunt to the point of cruelty about facts, he tells James the weather will be too bad to go to the Lighthouse.

snapshots.name: Mr. Ramsay
snapshots.subtitle: Mrs. Ramsay's husband; a philosopher
snapshots.body: Years after that summer he is back at the house, now a widower, determined to sail to the Lighthouse with Cam and James, and has already lost his temper over the delays.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Identity clarification released at the end of the reviewed source paragraph.

snapshots.name: Mr. Ramsay
snapshots.subtitle: Mrs. Ramsay's husband; a philosopher
snapshots.body: At seventy-one he has sailed with Cam and James to the Lighthouse. He praised James's steering at last, and sprang onto the rock with his parcel for the keepers like a young man.

snapshots.name: Lily Briscoe
snapshots.subtitle: A painter; guest of the Ramsays

snapshots.name: Lily Briscoe
snapshots.subtitle: A painter; guest of the Ramsays
snapshots.body: Back at the house after ten years, now forty-four, she has set up her easel on the same spot to finish the picture she never completed. Mr. Ramsay's demands and her anger at Mrs. Ramsay's death make it hard to begin.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Identity clarification released at the end of the reviewed source paragraph.

snapshots.name: Lily Briscoe
snapshots.subtitle: A painter; guest of the Ramsays
snapshots.body: Sensing that Mr. Ramsay has reached the Lighthouse, she draws a last line down the center of her canvas and finishes her picture: "I have had my vision."
